title: Whenever or Provided That
goal: Tell siempre que "whenever" (indicative) from siempre que "provided that" (subjunctive), and use cada vez que for "every time".
grammar: siempre que and cada vez que

items: I can tell siempre que "whenever" with the indicative from siempre que "provided that" with the subjunctive.
I can use cada vez que for "every time".
I can use the new words for habits.
